[EN] Mission Orders

Harvester golems are malfunctioning, threatening the safety of the residents of the Freeholds.

Destroy {@LinkCreature:19#2001#crazed}, {@LinkCreature:19#2003#wild}, {@LinkCreature:19#3001#berserk}, and {@LinkCreature:19#3003#reaping} harvester golems.

Report to Kayina when the mission is complete.
[ES] Órdenes de misión

Los golems recolectores están funcionando mal, amenazando la seguridad de los residentes de Freeholds.

Destruye a los golems recolectores {@LinkCreature:19#2001#crazed}, {@LinkCreature:19#2003#wild}, {@LinkCreature:19#3001#berserk} y {@LinkCreature:19#3003#reaping}.

Preséntate ante Kayina cuando la misión haya terminado.

[EN] You've earned the thanks of the federation. Your guild is an inspiration to all!
[ES] Te has ganado el agradecimiento de la federación. ¡Tu hermandad es una inspiración para todos!

[EN] It looks like you haven't completed your mission yet.
[ES] Parece que aún no has completado tu misión.
